Definition: a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsîyîy is the word for a desert-dweller, a wild beast. In Psalms 72:9, They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him, and it appears again in Isaiah 13:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wild things of the desert bow or flee before God, and no place is beyond His reach.
